[[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Slow (2, Hard Mode) |hidden = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Carrot Throw}}''' - Throws its carrot at a tower, which stuns the target and other towers in the immediate area. |ability2 = '''{{WikiAb|Shield}}''' - Holds its shield in front of its body, limiting most forms of damage towards it to a maximum of two. }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Sir Hopsalot''' was a knight-bunny enemy that exclusively appeared in [[Eggy Island]] as part of the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. This debuted in easy mode with 2,250 health and in hard mode with 2,750 health. '''Sir Hopsalot''' moved quite slowly in easy mode but moved just slightly slower than the [[Bunny]] in hard mode. '''Sir Hopsalot''' had two abilities. Similar to the [[Bunny]], it could throw a carrot club at a tower, which stunned it and any other towers in the immediate area. However, it could also use its shield to limit most forms of damage to two per firerate. ==Appearance== '''Sir Hopsalot''' wore a grey knight helmet, carried an egg shield and wielded a carrot club. It was similar in appearance to the [[Bunny]], except its torso had a pink egg design, instead of a grey one. It had grey skin and its bunny ears are sticking out of its helmet. ==Strategy== *The ''Shield'' ability is activated very often by '''Sir Hopsalot'''. As most forms of damage are capped to a maximum of two, towers with a fast firerate, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Crook Boss]] and [[Soldier]], are very effective against '''Sir Hopsalot'''. **Slow firing towers, such as the [[Sniper]] and [[Ranger|Outlaw]], are not recommended against '''Sir Hopsalot'''. *The [[Commander]] can be used to boost the firerate of towers and assist in defeating '''Sir Hopsalot'''. *In hard mode, [[units]], such as the [[Shotgunner|Enforcer]]'s [[SWAT Van]] and [[Military Base]]'s [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]], deal full collision damage to '''Sir Hopsalot'''. *The [[Pyromancer]], [[Electroshocker]] and [[Freezer]] are recommended to slow this enemy down. *Try not to cluster towers close together as '''Sir Hopsalot''' will be able to stun lots of them with just one ''Carrot Throw''. **You may also use cheap towers, such as the [[Scout]] or [[Soldier]], to distract '''Sir Hopsalot''' as it is immobile while performing its ''Carrot Throw'' ability. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} BunnyIcon.png|'''Sir Hopsalot''' on the game icon. }} ==Trivia== *Similar to the [[Bunny]], '''Sir Hopsalot''' was likely based on ''R2DA's'' [[w:c:r2da:Easter Costumes|Easter]] [[w:c:r2da:Brute|Brute]], in terms of attack. *The name '''Sir Hopsalot''' is a reference to Sir Lancelot, one of the greatest Knights of the Round Table. **'''Sir Hopsalot''' is a portmanteau of Sir Lancelot and the word "hop". ==Update History== *'''6 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0]] **'''Sir Hopsalot''' added. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Sir Hopsalot''' removed. {{EggyIsland|[[Bunny]]
